Live status requires Android 11 or later.

Identify which app owns the visible window on each second display. Android grants window-content access for this capability; Display Launcher only uses app identity. It does not record screen text, upload data, or perform gestures. This optional system-managed service can stay active until you disable it in Accessibility settings.

Android requires Accessibility window access to identify the app shown on a second display. This tool only uses window ownership; it does not record screen text, send data, or perform taps. The service can remain active while enabled. You can disable it at any time in system Accessibility settings. Without access, the tool will continue to show only its last launch record.
